# Phase guard for the generic assertion mask (M23-S1). A const switch over a
# type parameter records no assertion during the first check; lowering
# rewrites `const switch P { case *P: }` into a runtime type switch, and the
# final recheck of the rewritten body feeds the emitter, so the __.LOGOS
# member must carry AssertTP for the type parameter. The expected line is
# written by hand from the wire grammar in
# cmd/compile/internal/logos/facts/facts.go: version 3 header, 16-hex
# fingerprint, one `fn` record with the mandatory AssertTP/AssertRTP pair in
# canonical order; masks are lowercase hex, bit i = type parameter i. F has
# one type parameter feeding the lowered assertion (0x1) and no receiver type
# parameters (proven zero); no other flag is analyzed on F.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fingerprint [0-9a-f]{16}$'
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'

# Sweep GOARCH, optimization levels, and the plain-go command: the same
# assertion effects emit at O0 and O3, under js/wasm, and through plain
# go tool compile, per T-Sec5 every level, either command, any target.
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af-wasm.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-wasm.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
cd af
logos build -O=0 -o $WORK/af-o0.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-o0.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
cd af
logos build -O=3 -o $WORK/af-o3.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-o3.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOARCH=386
cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af-386.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-386.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOARCH=
cd af
go tool compile -p example.com/af -o $WORK/af-go.a af.lgo
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-go.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'

-- af/go.mod --
module example.com/af

go 1.27

-- af/af.lgo --
package af

func F[P any](x any) {
	const switch P {
	case *P:
	}
}
